name: fibonacci
summary: The nth Fibonacci number (F0 = 0, F1 = 1), iterated bottom-up in O(n).
vizCode: ({ datatype: 'array', input: [0,1,0,0,0,0,0], run(a) { for (let i = 2; i < a.length; i++) { a.cursor('i', i); a.set(i, a.get(i - 1) + a.get(i - 2)); a.mark(i, 'computed'); } a.markSorted(); } })
